verdict.rationale: Rev AI's features documentation says that when multiple speakers are detected, the transcript output is separated by speaker, which is speaker diarization labeling who said what. Diarization appears to happen automatically, so the 'request' part is satisfied implicitly, but the evidence is a single line. Missing for 10: details on the speaker label format in the JSON output, a parameter to set the number of speakers, whether diarization works in streaming, and independent or hands-on confirmation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request speaker diarization and the transcript labels who said what

citations.quote: When multiple speakers are detected, transcription output will be separated by speaker.
